rules.alternatives: Technicians registered from July 1, 2014 on after passing the PTCB (PTCE) or NHA (ExCPT) exam renew by submitting a current CPhT certification instead of Board CPE hours.
rules.notes: The 20 CPE hours apply to technicians registered before July 1, 2014 (or under W. Va. Code §30-1-27). Two-year reporting period July 1 – June 30. Rule effective July 1, 2026.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. §15-7-10 (Registration of Pharmacy Technicians)
rules.rule_quote: 10.2. A pharmacy technician who obtained registration prior to July 1, 2014, or as defined in W. Va. Code §30-1-27 shall complete a minimum of 20 CPE hours every two years in order to renew the registration.
